home.subheading: A government-grade decentralized voting system ensuring transparency, security, and accessibility for all citizens. Powered by blockchain technology and certified by national security standards.
home.securityNotice: Your vote is secure, private, and tamper-proof. Powered by blockchain technology.
home.castVoteSteps: Cast your vote in three simple steps. Your vote is secure, verified, and anonymous.
home.registerVerifyDesc: Create your secure account using government-issued ID verification. Receive your unique encrypted voter credentials.
home.castYourVoteDesc: Select your candidates and submit your vote. Each vote is encrypted and recorded on the blockchain instantly.
home.verifyTrackDesc: Receive a unique receipt code to verify your vote was counted. Your identity remains completely anonymous.
home.blockchainSecurityDesc: All votes are stored on the blockchain, making them immutable and transparent.
home.anonymousVotingDesc: Vote with privacy — no one can trace your identity or choice.
home.realTimeResultsDesc: Get instant, verified results once voting ends — no delays, no errors.
home.crossPlatformDesc: Vote from any device — mobile, tablet, or desktop securely.
home.endToEndEncryptionDesc: Every transaction and vote is encrypted to ensure data integrity.
home.zeroManipulationDesc: Blockchain consensus eliminates human bias or tampering.
home.readyToVote: Ready to Make Your Vote Count?
home.readyToVoteDesc: Enrol now to access the nation's trusted digital ballot. Verified identity, auditable results, and round-the-clock support for every citizen.
home.needHelp: Need help? Visit our comprehensive voter guide

voterGuideSteps.step1: Register with your verified identity. Keep credentials private.
voterGuideSteps.step2: Complete KYC and eligibility checks (confidential processing).
voterGuideSteps.step3: Review elections and candidate profiles for your constituency.
voterGuideSteps.step4: Cast your vote; your ballot is encrypted and recorded on-chain.
voterGuideSteps.step5: Verify inclusion using your reference without revealing your choice.

home.nationalPlatform: National Digital Voting Platform • ISO 27001 • Zero-Knowledge Audits

footer.description: Building a transparent, inclusive, and secure digital democracy. VoteChain leverages blockchain infrastructure, biometric verification, and national security standards to protect every ballot.
